_about: Ceilings for the weekly 10k-question Bench workflow (bench-workspace/1). Calibrated 2026-08-27 from two agreeing CI baseline runs (max observed value x5 headroom) so runner noise never trips an alarm but order-of-magnitude regressions always do. To re-baseline: dispatch the Bench workflow twice, compare the tables, update the limits, and record the change in the PR.
